newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks slip in London, autos firm.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks slip in London, autos firm.

text.p: Most Japanese shares weakened in thin trading in London on Friday after the benchmark average slipped in Tokyo.
The Nikkei 50 fell 2.67 points to 1,438.63 at 1435 GMT. In Tokyo, the benchmark Nikkei 225 lost 101.31 to settle at 20,929.73.

Activity was sparse in London, with most trading focused on the auto sector, which largely bucked the market's lower trend, dealers said. They said results from Toyota Motors Honda Motors sparked buying interest, dealer said.

Shares in Toyota were up 10 yen to 2,860, while Honda shares jumped 47.5 yen to 2882.5. Shares in Suzuki Motor added 10 yen to 1147.5. "Otherwise, I'd say it's been a typically slow Friday afternoon," said one.
